_source.frame: Priest magic on the planes runs on proximity to the granting power: sphere access degrades away from the power's home, and power keys are the sanctioned restoration. The boxes APPLY this law per plane rather than restating it — the precise distance ladder is printed in the campaign box (A DM Guide to the Planes), which is not yet distilled.

rows.rule: Priests casting on a plane that is not their power's home suffer the standard penalties for doing so — the boxes treat this as settled background law (Baator's divination text invokes it verbatim-by-reference: priests 'suffer the same penalties as always' off their power's plane).
rows.gap: the penalty ladder itself (sphere access by distance-from-power, by spell level) is campaign-box law (2600, A DM Guide to the Planes) — not yet distilled under build/; this row witnesses the frame, not the table. Joint pour candidate alongside M7.

rows.rule: A power key restores a priest's curtailed sphere access while planewalking: keys are deity-granted, usually sphere-specific (most often the granting power's specialty), conditional on the power's continued favor, and commonly time-limited or revocable. Every box applies this rule plane-by-plane — the per-plane grant policies, spheres, and shapes live in law:planar-keys:<plane>:power.

Attested sphere grants (the data behind the frame): Gray Waste keys restore a single sphere, the asking power's specialty (a Greek cleric's Healing sphere in Pluton, by Hades's leave); gnomish keys on Bytopia grant Major access to Protection and Elemental; Ilmater's grant All/Healing/Protection; Kiri-Jolith's grant All/Combat/Healing/Sun for a quest; Acheron's army keys cover Combat, Guardian, Healing, Necromancy, Protection, War; Baator's commonly Charm, Combat, Necromantic, Law, Thought, War, Wards; Limbo's powers favor Charm, Creation, Elemental (Fenmarel: Weather); Pandemonium's favor Charm, Guardian, Necromantic; Ysgard's release the granting power's interest (Thor's weather key exclusive to his faithful).
